title: Lightspeed is selling its OpenAI stake to a fund it will also run
excerpt: Lightspeed seeks $600m for a continuation fund holding OpenAI, Anthropic and three more. It sells the assets and will manage the vehicle buying them.
content_html:
The firm calls the deal Project Mercury, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with it.

It gathers assets from two Lightspeed funds, Select V and Opportunity II, plus a separately managed account. OpenAI is the anchor.

Coller Capital is the lead buyer. UBS is advising. Lightspeed did not reply to Bloomberg’s messages and Coller declined to comment.

What a continuation fund actually does

The mechanics matter more than the number, so here they are without jargon. A venture fund has a life, usually about ten years, and at the end it must sell what it holds and hand back the cash.

A continuation fund breaks that clock. The manager moves chosen holdings into a new vehicle, a buyer funds it, the original investors get their money, and the firm keeps the position.

Investors in the old fund can take the cash or roll into the new one. That choice is the product.

The problem it solves is real. Companies now stay private far longer than a decade, so the fund expires before the investment does.

Lightspeed sits on both sides of it

Here is the part that makes these deals contentious in private equity, and it arrives in venture unchanged. Lightspeed is selling the assets on behalf of one set of investors, and it will manage the vehicle that buys them.

Somebody has to price OpenAI for that transaction. There is no share price to consult, because the company is private.

The reference point is the last primary round, which valued OpenAI at $852bn post-money in March after a $122bn raise, per Tech Funding News.

Buyers set that number. Sellers did not. A continuation fund has to turn it into a transfer price, and the manager benefits from getting that price right for its own side.

Coller is the discipline here. It is an arm’s-length buyer with its own investors, and it has no reason to overpay.

The Anthropic line is not a rollover

One detail separates this from a straightforward extension. Bloomberg describes the Anthropic exposure as a new commitment rather than an existing holding.

So investors asked to roll are not only keeping what they had. They are funding a fresh position.

The entry point is steep. Anthropic’s last round valued it at $965bn, three months after a round at $380bn.

Lightspeed knows the company well, having backed it across three consecutive rounds including a $3.5bn Series E in 2025. Familiarity is not the same as a discount.

What else is in the box

The other assets spread the risk away from the frontier labs. Verkada makes AI physical security systems, and a CapitalG investment in December lifted it to $5.8bn.

Rippling, the workforce platform, raised at $16.8bn in May 2025. Glean, which builds enterprise AI search, raised at $7.2bn a month later.

Reflection AI has moved fastest. It raised at $8bn in October 2025. In March it reportedly sought fresh money at $25bn.

The desk has covered where its compute comes from. Reflection signed a $6.3bn compute deal with SpaceX for Nvidia chips running to 2029.

Why the structure is spreading

Follow the arithmetic rather than the fashion. AI valuations compound every few months. Defending a stake against dilution in later rounds costs hundreds of millions.

An ageing fund does not have that money. Its investors expect distributions, not more capital calls.

A continuation fund answers both problems at once. It raises new money against old assets and pays the original backers out of it.

The volumes show the trend. Venture-led secondary deals reached $35bn in 2025, roughly double the 2023 figure, according to PJT Partners.

That sits inside a secondaries market worth $121bn of transactions in the first half of this year alone.

The concentration underneath it

Read this against where venture money is already going. Megadeals took 87.5% of the dollars deployed in US venture in the second quarter.

A structure designed to hold winners longer will concentrate a market further, not loosen it. Lightspeed is not causing that, and it is responding to it rationally.

Other firms are restructuring at the same time. Accel raised $3.5bn across four funds in a single process this week.

And a single private stake can now define a whole firm. Thrive Capital’s first investor letter showed how completely OpenAI has come to define it.

Europe owns the buyer

The European angle is on the other side of the table. Coller Capital is a London secondaries specialist, and EQT, the Swedish investment group, recently acquired it.

So a Swedish-owned, London-based firm is the lead buyer of Silicon Valley’s most valuable private AI positions.

That is a quiet reversal of the usual direction. European capital normally shows up in these stories as the thing being bought.

It is also a reminder of what secondaries firms do. They are the market of last resort for illiquid assets, and they are now the price-setters for private AI.

What would settle it

Three things, and the first is the price. The transfer valuation for the OpenAI stake would show whether Coller paid the March mark, a premium or a discount.

That number is the closest thing to an independent read on OpenAI available today. It is also the number nobody will publish.

The second is how many investors take the cash rather than roll. A high rollover says the LPs share the conviction. A low one says they wanted out and the structure gave them a door.

The third is the exit that ends the argument. Investors expect Anthropic to list in October at $2trn or more, and OpenAI would follow at some point.

Until one of those happens, every valuation in this deal is a private agreement between people who benefit from it being high. That is not an accusation. It is the definition of a private market, and a continuation fund is what you build when you want to stay in one.

content_html_zh:
彭博社援引知情人士的话报道称，该公司将该交易称为“水星计划”。

它收集了来自两个 Lightspeed 基金 Select V 和 Opportunity II 的资产，以及一个单独管理的账户。 OpenAI 是锚。

Coller Capital 是主要买家。 瑞银正在提供建议。 Lightspeed 没有回复彭博社的消息，科勒也拒绝发表评论。

持续基金的实际作用是什么

机制比数字更重要，所以这里没有行话。 风险基金有一个寿命，通常约为十年，最后它必须出售其持有的资产并返还现金。

延续基金打破了这个时钟。 经理将选定的资产转移到新的工具中，买家为其提供资金，原始投资者获得资金，而公司则保留该头寸。

旧基金的投资者可以拿走现金，也可以转入新基金。 这个选择就是产品。

它解决的问题是真实的。 目前，公司保持私有状态的时间远远超过十年，因此基金在投资到期之前就到期了。

光速位于它的两侧

这就是这些交易在私募股权领域引起争议的部分，而在风险投资领域却没有变化。 Lightspeed 代表一组投资者出售资产，并将管理购买这些资产的工具。

必须有人为 OpenAI 的交易定价。 由于该公司是私营公司，因此没有股价可供参考。

据 Tech Funding News 报道，参考点是最后一轮初选，在 3 月份融资 1220 亿美元后，OpenAI 的投后估值为 8520 亿美元。

买家设定了这个数字。 卖家没有。 延续基金必须将其转化为转让价格，而管理人可以从适合自己一方的价格中受益。

科勒是这里的纪律。 它是一个与自己的投资者保持一定距离的买家，没有理由多付钱。

人择线不是翻转

一个细节将其与简单的扩展区分开来。 彭博社将 Anthropic 的投资描述为一项新的承诺，而不是现有的持有。

因此，要求展期的投资者不仅保留了他们所拥有的资产。 他们正在资助一个新职位。

入口点很陡。 Anthropic 上一轮估值为 9650 亿美元，三个月前一轮估值为 3800 亿美元。

Lightspeed 对该公司非常了解，已连续三轮支持该公司，其中包括 2025 年 35 亿美元的 E 轮融资。 熟悉度并不等于折扣。

盒子里还有什么

其他资产将风险从前沿实验室分散开。 Verkada 生产人工智能物理安全系统，12 月份 CapitalG 的投资使其增至 58 亿美元。

劳动力平台 Rippleing 于 2025 年 5 月筹集了 168 亿美元。 构建企业人工智能搜索的 Glean 一个月后筹集了 72 亿美元。

反射人工智能发展最快。 2025 年 10 月筹集了 80 亿美元。 据报道，3 月份该公司寻求 250 亿美元的新资金。

桌子已经涵盖了其计算的来源。 Reflection 与 SpaceX 签署了价值 63 亿美元的计算协议，购买 Nvidia 芯片，运行至 2029 年。

为什么结构会扩散

遵循算术而不是时尚。 人工智能估值每隔几个月就会复合一次。 在后续几轮中保护股份不被稀释需要花费数亿美元。

老龄化基金没有这笔钱。 其投资者期望的是分配，而不是更多的资本需求。

持续基金可以同时解决这两个问题。 它用旧资产筹集新资金，并从中支付给原始支持者。

成交量显示了趋势。 PJT Partners 的数据显示，到 2025 年，风险投资主导的二级交易将达到 350 亿美元，大约是 2023 年数字的两倍。

仅今年上半年，二级市场的交易额就达 1210 亿美元。

其下方的浓度

请对照风险投资的去向来阅读这篇文章。 第二季度，大型交易占美国风险投资资金的 87.5%。

旨在让赢家保持更长时间的结构将进一步集中市场，而不是放松市场。 光速并不是造成这种情况的原因，它正在理性地对此做出反应。

其他公司也在同时进行重组。 Accel 本周在一个流程中通过四只基金筹集了 35 亿美元。

现在，单一的私人股份可以定义整个公司。 Thrive Capital 的第一封投资者信显示了 OpenAI 对其的定义是多么彻底。

欧洲拥有买家

欧洲角在桌子的另一边。 Coller Capital 是一家伦敦二级市场专业公司，最近被瑞典投资集团 EQT 收购。

因此，一家总部位于伦敦的瑞典公司是硅谷最有价值的私人人工智能职位的主要买家。

这是对通常方向的悄然逆转。 欧洲资本通常在这些故事中作为被购买的东西出现。

这也提醒人们二级公司的工作。 它们是非流动资产的最后手段市场，现在是私人人工智能的价格制定者。

什么可以解决它

三件事，第一是价格。 OpenAI 股份的转让估值将显示 Coller 是否支付了 3 月份的价格、溢价还是折扣。

这个数字是目前最接近 OpenAI 独立读物的数字。 这也是没有人会发布的数字。

第二个是有多少投资者接受现金而不是展期。 高额换手率表明有限合伙人也有同样的信念。 一个低矮的人说他们想出去，而这个建筑给了他们一扇门。

第三个是结束争论的出口。 投资者预计 Anthropic 将于 10 月份以 2 万亿美元或更高的价格上市，OpenAI 将在某个时候跟进。

在其中之一发生之前​​，这笔交易中的每一项估值都是受益于高估值的人们之间的私下协议。 这不是指控。 这是私人市场的定义，而持续基金是当您想留在私人市场时建立的。
